proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ _ _ A B
  have hd : Disjoint (A \ B) (B \ A) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]; intro x hx hx'; simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff] at hx hx'; exact hx.2 hx'.1
  have h0 : (((A \ B) ∪ (B \ A)).card : ℝ) = (A \ B).card + (B \ A).card := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hd
  have h1 : ((A \ B).card : ℝ) + (A ∩ B).card = A.card := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_inter A B
  have h2 : ((B \ A).card : ℝ) + (B ∩ A).card = B.card := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_inter B A
  rw [Finset.inter_comm] at h2
  rw [mul_div_assoc', ← add_div, ← sub_div]
  congr 1
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [Nonempty Ω] (A B : Finset Ω), (((A \ B) ∪ (B \ A)).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω = (A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω + (B.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω - 2 * (((A ∩ B).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω)
